observations: A temporary row trigger records INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE transitions in the disposable fixture transaction.

A system force release/takeover using the old claim_id cannot mutate the replacement incarnation.
Source acquire followed by system expiry and sweep leaves empty endpoints while the observer retains INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.
